name: Activity type: Raster rendering
abstract: Depicts a raster as an image for viewing, giving each cell a colour from a colour map that associates values, or classes of values, with colours.

sources.title: OGC 05-077r4 Symbology Encoding Implementation Specification 1.1.0, §11.5 Raster Symbolizer (ColorMap with the Categorize or Interpolate function)
